subject: The wardroom of the colony ship ariadne at supper, one table and one pot. Hamond waits until everyone has a bowl, then stands, which nobody asked him to, and says a grace. It starts with the beans in the stew, wanders by way of his mother's kitchen and his uncle Tarek's goat, and arrives at Dalia asleep in the cryo banks, who would be telling him to sit down. The stew has stopped steaming. Only these two officers are seen clearly; the other four at the table or on the ship are faceless: backs turned, in shadow or cut off by the frame.
card: soc.grace, version dahl+waititi (js/content-social-alt.js; tests and effects in js/content-social.js)
notes: A crew photo for one pairing of this card's two leads. The incident is NOT the plain soc scene with faces swapped: this version of the card was rewritten for these two people (title: Grace). Read the version's text for what must be visible. Quiet, small stakes, nothing has gone wrong yet.
